description: This file defines the NoteService class which provides CRUD operations for Note objects, including ownership verification and database interactions via NoteRepository.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for Note objects with ownership validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note owned by the specified user.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes owned by a user with pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: getOwned
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID ensuring it belongs to the specified user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the title and content of a note owned by the provided user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the specified user.
